description: Before d89da44 (#101), KernelModelPort kept only the last provider result of a multi-round assistant turn and the executor charged and recorded only that call. Every earlier round (tool-call rounds before the reply) was billed by the provider but never added to total_cost_usd, never checked against the profile's max_cost_usd, and never written to evidence. For any bundle whose harness ran more than one model round per action attempt, the published total_cost_usd is a lower bound and the declared cost ceiling did not bound the dominant spend path. Single-round attempts (max_rounds == 1), which is every Housing and procurement campaign to date, are unaffected. This record selects the known affected publication by campaign and plan digest. It deliberately does not use an implementation-pin selector: every receipt sealed before d89da44 carries a pre-fix execution-module digest, but the effect depends on the profile's harness max_rounds, which receipts do not carry, so a pin selector would flag single-round runs that are not affected. To audit other bundles: list the pre-fix digests with `git log <KernelModelPort-introduction>..d89da44^ -- src/aeread/shared_runner/task/execution.py src/aeread/shared_runner/execution.py` (31 distinct file digests), resolve them with plans_sealed_under(), and keep only plans whose harness profile declares max_rounds > 1. Known affected publication: tau3_retail_glm5p2_arena_pipeline_proof_v9 (PR #97; assistant seat max_rounds 12).
title: Multi-round model turns were costed only on their final round
